meaning:
1) to remain over, be in excess
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to be in excess
1a1a) excess (subst)
1a1b) surplus (participle)
1b) (Hiphil) to have a surplus

renderings.kjv: on the other side of that which remaineth

elsewhere.note: When they measured it with an omer, he who gathered much had nothing over, and he who gathered little had no lack. They each gathered according to his eating.
then let him reckon the years since its sale, and restore the surplus to the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return to his property.
